name: @qvac/model-fit
description: Memory-fit preflight addon for QVAC — wraps llama.cpp's common_fit_params to project whether a GGUF model fits available device memory before loading it

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:native
scripts.build:native: bare-make generate && bare-make build && bare-make install
scripts.check:generated: npm run build:ts && git diff --exit-code -- index.js index.d.ts
scripts.build:pack: npm run build:ts && mkdir -p dist && npm pack --pack-destination dist
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:ts && npm run test:integration:generate && bare test/integration/all.js --exit
scripts.test:integration:generate: brittle -r test/integration/all.js test/integration/*.test.js && npm run test:mobile:generate
scripts.test:types: npm run typecheck && npm run test:types:consumer && npm run check:generated
scripts.mobile:copy-prebuilds: cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-ia32 || echo 'Warning: Failed to copy model-fit prebuilds to android-ia32'; cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-arm || echo 'Warning: Failed to copy model-fit prebuilds to android-arm'; cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-x64 || echo 'Warning: Failed to copy model-fit prebuilds to android-x64'; cp -r prebuilds/ios-arm64 prebuilds/ios-arm64-simulator 2>/dev/null || echo 'iOS prebuilds already present'; cp -r prebuilds/ios-arm64 prebuilds/ios-x64-simulator 2>/dev/null || echo 'iOS prebuilds already present'

author: Tether
